messages:
Jordan Lee: Hey team — trying to finish onboarding but stuck. I click the Okta 'Sign in with Google' link and it immediately redirects me to an 'account mismatch' page. I do have a personal Google account that shares a similar email alias. Also 1Password says I don't have a seat. Can someone point me at the minimal steps to get temp Drive access and finish SSO?

Sasha (IT): Hi Jordan — welcome! Two quick checks: 1) try signing out of all Google accounts or open an incognito window, 2) if that doesn't work, we can re-send an invite to an alternate address. Can you confirm the exact email you used for the Okta invite? Also do you have a security key or just phone MFA right now?

Jordan Lee: Thanks Sasha. I used jordan.lee@redwood.com in the onboarding form, but I also have jordan.lee@gmail.com that sometimes auto-selects. I tried incognito and it still jumps back with the mismatch. No YubiKey yet — only my phone.

Sasha (IT): Got it. Two options I can try from my side: 1) reprovision the Okta invite to jordan.lee+work@gmail.com so Google won't auto-select, or 2) enable an Okta account-selection prompt. I'll also add you to a temporary team folder share so you can access Drive while we sort SSO.

Sasha (IT): If you want to try one more local thing, in Chrome: clear the accounts cookies and force account chooser:
```
- open chrome://settings/siteData
- search for "accounts.google.com" and remove
- open an incognito window and paste the Okta link
```

Onboarding Bot: Ticket #4281 created for IT:okta -> assigned to Sasha. ETA 2 business hours.

Ben (People Ops): Jordan — I approved a 1Password seat request tied to ticket #4285. Sasha, can you confirm group assignment so the seat shows up? Asha, can you confirm manager approval?

Asha (Manager): Approved. Welcome aboard Jordan! I've asked ops to add you to the "team-drive-engineering" folder. Ping me if anything still blocked. :wave:

Sasha (IT): Confirmed — reprovisioned invite to jordan.lee+work@gmail.com and added a provisional Drive share (view-only) so you can get started. 1Password seat is pending group sync; it should appear within 10–15 minutes. We'll ship a YubiKey to your address — use phone MFA for now and enroll the key once it arrives.

Jordan Lee: Perfect, I can get in to Drive now and saw the 1Password invite come through. Thanks everyone! One last Q — where do I find the quickstart for setting up passkeys/YubiKey later?

Sasha (IT): Quickstart doc is in the /handbook/it/onboarding page. If you want direct steps: enroll phone MFA in Okta > go to Security Methods > Add Security Key > follow the browser prompt. If you run into an issue, DM me and I'll walk through it. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: Awesome — thanks Sasha, Ben, Asha. All good for now.
